pages.name: Open Sicilian 5...e5 6. Bb5+ Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 advance with White's bishop on b5; plan 3 said Nf5 trades off a defender of d5. Rewrote plans 1-3 around the d5-hole, the Bb5 pin and 7.Nf5 (the reviewer noted the d4-knight is attacked by e5 and must move); British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense, Spielmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named the f5- and h5-squares in a way that read as moves. Reworded plan 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense, Yates Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Kh1 before castling was played; plan 1 suggested f3 where f4 is the normal plan with Bd3. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview (including less-travelled, caught by the reviewer).

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Classical Variation, Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 said a ...Bg7 fianchetto neutralises the g2-bishop (the bishops are on different colours); plan 3 routed a knight from f3 that does not exist. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Spielmann Variation
pages.notes: The overview said Nde2 avoids doubled pawns after an exchange on c3; plan 2 named f5 in a way that read as a move. Rewrote the overview and plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Venice Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Open, 2...d6, 5.Nc3 Bd7 6.Bg5

pages.name: Sicilian: Open, 2...d6, 5.Nc3 Nbd7
